title: CFA® Level III Complete Course
shortDescription: Portfolio management and wealth planning: asset allocation, derivatives strategies, and constructed-response practice.
description: Level III shifts from valuation to portfolio management. This course focuses on asset allocation, portfolio construction across asset classes, private wealth and institutional investors, and writing concise constructed-response answers.
whoFor: Candidates who have passed CFA® Level II
outcomes: Design strategic asset allocations for individuals and institutions
Manage equity, fixed income and alternative portfolios
Use derivatives and currency management to implement views and hedge risk
Evaluate performance and comply with GIPS

faq.q: Is the full course available now?
faq.a: The course structure is published. Lessons are released progressively.
